text:
alex: Heads-up — our Wed RFC review is showing up twice in a bunch of people's calendars (one with the old Zoom link). Noticed the recurring invite got duplicated when someone forwarded the series last month. Can we clean this up before tomorrow?

maya: ugh, yeah I saw that. One series is in UTC, the other got saved as floating (no TZ) so Outlook/GCal pick different local times. :grimacing:

sam: Which link should we keep? The one with the pass-through Zoom pupper? (that one has the recording enabled we rely on)

alex: Keep the recording-enabled link (zoom.us/j/99999). The floating one is zoom.us/j/44444 and is the old personal room.

liam: Quick checklist: 1) cancel duplicate series, 2) create a new canonical team series in the Team Calendar (not personal), 3) set conference field to the Zoom link, 4) resend invites. I can do 1–3 if y'all agree.

sandra: Agree. Also let's add explicit timezone in the event title for now ("RFC Review — 16:00 PDT / 01:00 CEST") so people in APAC don't get confused.

maya: And can we add a note in the invite with the canonical link + a short note about "do not forward series; invite new guests individually"? Forwarding seems to be the cause.

alex: Good call. If someone forwarded the series that created the floating copy — GCal treats forwarded recurring invites weird when recipients are in different domains.

sam: If you'd like, I can run a quick export to confirm all attendees are on the canonical series. Posted this snippet earlier when I debugged:

```
# list attendees for gcal event
gcal-cli events --calendar "team@redwood.com" --id EVENT_ID --json | jq '.attendees[] | {email,displayName}'
```

liam: Nice. If anyone sees the floating series in their calendar, please delete it (don't just decline). Deleting the event removes the local copy that keeps showing the wrong link.

sandra: I'll update the Team Calendar and add the timezone title hack for the next two occurrences. Also adding a line in the agenda: "If you joined the old link, drop a note here so we can tag your recording segment."

maya: Can we also pin the agenda in the #eng-platform channel and link the new invite so it's easy to find?

alex: Yes — I'll pin and post the new invite in this thread once Liam confirms the new series is live.

liam: Working on it now. Creating the new series under team@redwood.com and setting recording-enabled Zoom as the conference. Will set recurrence to weekly with rrule: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=WE;COUNT=52 and explicit TZ=America/Los_Angeles.

calendar-bot: Updated series: eventId=ev_1845abc, organizer=team@redwood.com, conference=zoom.us/j/99999 (recording enabled). Old series ev_1792xyz marked CANCELLED.

sam: Awesome — I'll go through and delete the floating ones from my calendar and ping anyone who still has the old link in their invites.

sandra: Thanks everyone. Small ops note: for future, when inviting external reviewers, please add them via the event UI (Add guests) rather than forwarding the series. Forwarded series often cause the floating/duplicate copies problem across providers.

alex: Resolution: Liam created canonical series and calendar-bot cancelled the old one. Everyone please delete any duplicate local copies and RSVP to the new invite. I'll pin the agenda and post the new link here in 5. :thumbsup:
